name: @odu/face
//: WHAT EVERY ROW'S FACE SHARES, and nothing a server needs: the design system (`./theme.css` — the Night shift tokens, and what every primitive looks like; `./theme` — which of its two schemes is showing), the primitives themselves (`./ui` — the button, the field, the pill, the panel, the lane strip, the confirmation, the receipt), the one control state machine (`./control` — idle, busy, then an answer or a refusal, retired with its owner) and the sentence a refusal becomes (`./refusal`). In NO row, after `@odu/credentials`'s precedent: two or more rows import it and none owns it. Not `@odu/cordis`, which is the contract host and rows share and must not carry a UI runtime into every server-side consumer.
//dependencies: `solid-js` (the control's signals, and every component here) and `effect` (the type of what a control runs). No `@odu/*` at all. `src/closure.test.ts` pins both.
//theme.css: An export so the one path to the stylesheet is in the manifest rather than in a build script's string literal. `scripts/build-web-ui.ts` reads it, rewrites the two font placeholders in it, and ships it content-hashed beside the bundle; nothing imports it as a module.
